details: The Federal Reserve has maintained its interest rates, a decision that saw the broader cryptocurrency market remain largely flat. While three officials reportedly pushed for a rate hike, the outcome contributes to ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty impacting crypto investor sentiment.
title: Fed Holds Rates Steady as Crypto Market Stays Flat

details: Morgan Stanley has launched new Exchange Traded Products (ETPs) for Ethereum and Solana, notably featuring staking benefits and highly competitive management fees of 0.14%. This move signals growing institutional confidence and provides more accessible investment avenues for both traditional and crypto-native investors, including robo-advisors and portfolio managers.
title: Morgan Stanley Debuts ETH & SOL ETPs with Staking Benefits

details: A recent report by blockchain security firm Blockaid reveals that crypto exploits hit a record high in the first half of 2026. A total of 212 incidents led to approximately $1 billion in losses, averaging $5.4 million per exploit. This underscores persistent security risks within the digital asset ecosystem.
title: Crypto Exploits Reach Record High in First Half of 2026

details: Emirates, a major international airline, has integrated Crypto.com Pay, allowing eligible residents in the UAE to book flights using cryptocurrencies. This initiative supports Dubai's push towards a cashless economy and represents a significant step in the real-world adoption and utility of digital assets for everyday transactions.
title: Emirates Launches Crypto.com Pay for Flight Bookings
